headline: Deficit target within reach. Surprise from ministries: savings of €600 million
summary: Italian ministries exceeded spending-cut requests, finding savings of €600 million. The article says the deficit target is within reach, compared with a €2.3 billion spending cut that had been requested.
why: Italy's public deficit and debt levels are closely watched by investors, and government spending control affects Italian government bond yields.
